summary: Stack traces in 500 bodies leak file paths and can include connection strings; customers should only get error.code/message/request_id. Debug logs hold stacks; audit logs hold who/what/outcome. Join key is request_id.
evidence: GET /debug/error body is {"error":{"code":"internal_error","message":"internal server error","request_id":"req-dd549a9a"}} SERVER_HAS_TRACE False. The same request logs stack_trace with api/app/main.py line 314 RuntimeError — that is debug, not the client contract.

Audit vs debug: 401 for DO_NOT_LOG_ME_123 logs status=401 error_detail=Invalid API key request_id=... and SENTINEL_IN_LOGS False. Debug would be the stack on 500; audit is method/path/status/principal without secrets.
Incident fields we actually emit: request_id, method, path, status, duration_ms, error_type/stack_trace on 500. Customer quotes X-Request-ID from the envelope and header.
